newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea to tender to buy 20,000T of pork in Jan.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea to tender to buy 20,000T of pork in Jan.

text.p: South Korea will tender to buy 20,000 tonnes of pork in January to ease domestic prices, the Ministry of Agriculture and Forestry said on Friday.
The ministry said in a statement domestic pork prices were hovering at around 173,000 won per 100 kg, up from 133,000 won a year earlier.
It also said the nation's pork imports were estimated at 38,392 tonnes in 1996, up from 34,638 tonnes in 1995.
Pork exports were expected to rise 49 percent to 55,000 tonnes in 1997 from an estimated 37,000 tonnes in 1996, the statement said.
South Korea has said it would open its pork market to imports from July 1 this year.
